segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the serum as helping control oil throughout the day, improving texture, and giving a glow, though one very oily-skin reviewer notes tolerating the scent is required for it to work.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report the serum clears peeling and dryness quickly and leaves skin soft, though one mature reviewer with very dry, extremely sensitive skin also notes softness with continued use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report smoother texture, reduced small bumps, and no pilling or sensitivity.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most vocal group and split sharply: many report zero irritation, gentle exfoliation, glow and clearer skin even with eczema or psoriasis, while others describe burning, swelling, cystic breakouts, or having to stop use entirely.
segments.mature: One 59-year-old reviewer with very dry, extremely sensitive mature skin reports softer, smoother skin using it every other day.

concerns.aging: The one mature-skin reviewer reports softer, smoother skin with regular use, with no other age-specific claims made.
concerns.dehydration: Dry-skin reviewers report the serum resolves peeling and dryness overnight and leaves skin soft and hydrated; no dissent noted on this point.
concerns.redness: Reviewers using it for redness report calming of inflammation, reduced redness and post-inflammatory erythema (PIE) scars overnight; no negative reports specific to redness.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers describe the serum as barrier-gentle or even used to help protect a compromised barrier, but two reviewers explicitly report it burned and irritated their skin barrier and one found her barrier compromised after starting.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and sun damage marks over weeks of use, with one describing purposeful, beneficial peeling; results are generally described as gradual.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority report clearer skin, faster clearing of hormonal, cystic, and closed-comedone breakouts, sometimes within days; however several reviewers report the opposite — new whiteheads, deep cystic acne, or horrible breakouts triggered by the product.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report reduced oil control throughout the day and less oily-looking skin over time; no dissent reported on this concern.

extraits.titre: Not good for sensitive, acne prone skin
extraits.texte: I got this mandelic acid serum after doing research on AHA's that are good for acne prone sensitive skin because mandelic acid is supposed to be more gentle. Unfortunately it was not. My skin immediately burned when i put it on and the next day I had huge cystic pimples all over me. It also feels extremely sticky on the skin. Still on the hunt for a gentle AHA that wont bother my sensitive and acne prone skin. I really like the Good Molecules hyaluronic acid serum, but unfortunately I can't seem to find an AHA that works for my skin.

I loveeeee good molecules bc a lot of their products have saved my skin in the past. Unfortunately the pilling on my skin bc of this is so freaking bad. I've tried using different moisturizer and still pilling. I've even looked up the correct way to layer it and it literally still pilling! I wanted to love this so bad because I am a true ride or die for molecules, but this just wasn't for me and I didn't even clear my dark spots :/

I dont think ive ever written a product review in my life but i felt so compelled to recommend this to other people! I have insanely sensitive, acne prone, oily skin. Awful combo for the girlies that need regular exfoliation but are also sensitive to everything. This is other wordly tbh. It gently exfoliates without irritating my skin - AT ALL. I mean zero irritation. I can use this multiple nights in a row as well when im feeling extra congested and the glow is like nothing else ive experienced before! Both instantly and over time. And for the price?! I cant recommend this more!! Get it!!

I have very sensitive, dry, acne prone skin and this has helped me a lot. Most exfoliaters have been too harsh, and honestly this is too much to use as directed, but I've had the best luck with applying for 5-10 minutes once or twice a week and then washing it off. Only helps a bit with dark spots, but is absolutely the best way to get rid of dead skin and keep clear pores.
Very gentle. I'm using it every other day and not experiencing any irritation. My skin is softer and smoother, so i believe it is working over time. My 59 yo skin is very dry and extremely sensitive.

extraits.titre: The Active I've been Looking For!
extraits.texte: I have tried a lot of actives and most of them were far too strong for my skin. I have combo-oily skin but also suffer from eczema so I gravitate towards babying my skin as much as possible. I've been using this for 3 weeks and I already notice a difference, the purging has already come and gone, took a week max. I've pretty much entirely replaced my morning and night regimens with good molecule products.
